assumptions: This optional foreign-liability planning reserve uses domestic US reference cohorts, not a Mexican crossborder premium or a verified policy.
Apply the owner-operator annual range to one planning MX tractor pool without inferring a per-power-unit sample denominator.
New-authority Indiana and experienced clean-record observations remain distinct alternatives; the pilot carrier history is not selected.
The 2025 period is explicit only for the new-authority book-of-business claim; do not relabel the experienced range as 2025 or 2026.
Published endpoints are sensitivity choices, not market bounds, medians, calibrated prices or a forecast probability distribution.
Transfer the annual premium unchanged: no invented foreign-country, commercial-zone, mileage, claim, tax or inflation multiplier.
Annual pool allocation reuses MAX(MXcycleKm/MXmonthlyKm, MXelapsedDays/24)/12; no extra certificate or bridge multiplier.
Only MX foreign primary liability is represented here; domestic MX package, existing US package and one box policy remain separate.
Source excludes own truck and cargo; do not subtract or add physical damage to isolate this liability-only reference.
Annual and temporary foreign liability are mutually exclusive alternatives; no temporary price is published or inferred from annual/365.
Taxes, fees, deductible, insured limit, risk acceptance and actual coverage remain unverified, not zero-valued facts.
The same planning expense applies across cash and financing modes; debt payment does not multiply an annual liability premium.
The unpriced default preserves prior costs. Complete CFU, CVU and D2D outputs remain null; no business operation or policy purchase occurs.
